title: Robustness Analysis of Pareto-based Joint Evaluation of Fairness and Relevance in Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.27850v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommender Systems (RSs) can be evaluated for many aspects, two of them being recommendation relevance and fairness. These two aspects can be evaluated either in isolation, using a measure for each aspect; or jointly with a single`relevance-aware' fairness measure that quantifies fairness with respect to relevance. Yet, neither approach provides a simultaneous evaluation of both relevance and fairness: the first approach may result in two different rankings of models, each corresponding to an evaluation aspect; the second approach often provides an imbalanced evaluation of the two aspects. To address this gap, we propose Distance to Pareto Frontier (DPFR), a new approach to jointly evaluate RS fairness and relevance. DPFR is based on a Pareto frontier of relevance and fairness scores from existing measures. The frontier is generated from user-item interaction data and represents various Pareto-optimal trade-offs between the two aspects.

translated_title: 基于Pareto的推荐系统中公平性与相关性联合评估的鲁棒性分析
translated_abstract: 推荐系统（RSs）可以从多个方面进行评估，其中两个方面是推荐相关性和公平性。这两个方面既可以分别独立评估，即对每个方面使用一个度量指标；也可以联合评估，即使用单一的“相关性感知”公平性度量来量化相对于相关性的公平性。然而，这两种方法都无法同时对相关性和公平性进行评估：第一种方法可能导致两种不同的模型排名，每种排名对应一个评估方面；第二种方法通常对这两个方面的评估是不平衡的。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了Pareto前沿距离（DPFR），这是一种联合评估推荐系统公平性和相关性的新方法。DPFR基于现有度量指标得到的相关性和公平性得分构建的Pareto前沿。该前沿由用户-物品交互数据生成，代表了两个方面的各种Pareto最优权衡。
tldr: 提出了一种名为Pareto前沿距离（DPFR）的新方法，通过基于用户-物品交互数据构建相关性与公平性得分的Pareto前沿，实现对推荐系统公平性和相关性的联合且平衡的评估。
en_tdlr: Proposes Distance to Pareto Frontier (DPFR), a new approach that jointly and balancedly evaluates both fairness and relevance in recommender systems by constructing a Pareto frontier of relevance and fairness scores from user-item interaction data.
